source.data_source: Ladson 1988 NASA TM-4074, 120-grit zone (recommended baseline). Re=6e6, M=0.15, transition tripped at LE.

mesh_cell_count.description: Total cell count of the airfoil mesh (single mesh used across alpha sweep)
mesh_cell_count.T_good_source: C-grid or O-grid sufficient to resolve y+<1 on a 1-m chord at Re=6e6 typically requires ~50k-150k cells in 2D. Hand-set; calibrate via mesh-convergence study.

final_residual_U.description: Final momentum residual at end of alpha=8 deg solve (representative of converged state)
final_residual_U.T_good_source: Hand-set; steady RANS on attached airfoil flow routinely reaches 1e-5

CL_at_alpha_4.T_good_source: Ladson 1988 120-grit at alpha=4.11deg, CL=0.4397. T_good ~5% accommodates RANS/turbulence-model spread; T_bad 22% catches gross misprediction.

CL_at_alpha_10.T_good_source: Ladson 1988 120-grit at alpha=10.10deg, CL=1.0775. Slightly looser tolerance because near-stall sensitivity to turbulence model rises.

CL_at_alpha_12.T_good_source: Ladson 1988 120-grit at alpha=12.13deg, CL=1.2720. Pre-stall scatter between turbulence models is larger here.

CD_at_alpha_4.description: Drag coefficient at alpha=4 deg (mostly viscous)
CD_at_alpha_4.T_good_source: Ladson 1988 120-grit at alpha=4.11deg, CD=0.00879 = ~88 drag-counts. T_good=10 dc is industry threshold for design-grade RANS.

CD_at_alpha_10.T_good_source: Ladson 1988 120-grit at alpha=10.10deg, CD=0.01175 = ~118 drag-counts. T_good=15 dc to allow for finite-AoA induced effects in 2D.

CL_alpha_slope_per_deg.description: Linear-regression slope of CL vs alpha (deg) over the linear regime alpha=0..8 deg
CL_alpha_slope_per_deg.T_good_source: Computed from Ladson 1988 120-grit endpoints alpha=-0.01 (CL=-0.0120) and alpha=8.08 (CL=0.8701): slope=0.1090/deg. Thin-airfoil theory predicts 0.1097/deg; T_good=0.005 catches gross misprediction but allows minor turbulence-model drift.
